description: Check whether a shop is an authorized retailer of a brand, from the shop's domain or URL plus the brand or one of its products' GTIN (EAN). Read-only. Use this when you know the seller's domain, e.g. from a shopping or UCP catalog result. Pass exactly one of 'brand' or 'gtin'; a GTIN resolves the product's brand and the check stays brand-level. status: AUTHORIZED = authorization active: the brand has confirmed this shop on authorized.by; official_shop, partnership_date and certificate_url / certificate_url_de prove it, share the certificate link when a user needs proof. NO_RECORD_FOR_BRAND = the shop and the brand are on authorized.by, but this brand has not confirmed this shop there (also when a GTIN belongs to several brands and not exactly one confirmed it; brand is then null). RETAILER_NOT_REGISTERED = no public shop on authorized.by at this domain. BRAND_NOT_REGISTERED = no public brand or product matches 'brand' or 'gtin'. None of these statuses means that the shop is unauthorized. Domains match exactly, never a parent domain or another subdomain (www. and m. count as the same shop); marketplace hosts such as amazon.de or ebay.de only match the exact store URL. The answer is computed live, never cached. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

brand.description: Brand numeric ID, slug, alias or website domain, e.g. 'deuter' or 'deuter.com'. Use get_brands to find the slug from a name. Omit when passing 'gtin'.

gtin.description: GTIN / EAN of a product of the brand, 8 to 14 or 18 digits. Omit when passing 'brand'.

retailer_domain.description: Shop domain or URL, e.g. 'best-shop.de' or 'https://www.best-shop.de/de/grills'.

name: verify_retailer_authorization

outputSchema.description: Outcome of the authorization check, with certificate links when AUTHORIZED.

brand.description: The checked brand; null when the shop or the brand is not registered, or when a GTIN matches several brands and not exactly one of them confirmed the shop.

id.description: Numeric authorized.by ID. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

certificate_url.description: Public authorized.by certificate page (English) that proves the authorization; null when there is no active authorization.

certificate_url_de.description: Same certificate page in German; null when there is no active authorization.

checked_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) the check was made; answers are never cached.

gtin.description: The checked GTIN, normalized to 14 digits (18 for GTIN-18); null when checked by brand.

official_shop.description: Whether this shop is the brand's own official shop.

partnership_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the authorization STARTED. Not a last-verified date: every listed partnership is active as of the response.

retailer.description: The authorized.by shop registered at this domain; null when there is none.

id.description: Numeric authorized.by ID. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

retailer_domain.description: The checked shop domain and path, as parsed from the request.

status.description: Outcome of the check: AUTHORIZED (authorization active), NO_RECORD_FOR_BRAND, RETAILER_NOT_REGISTERED or BRAND_NOT_REGISTERED. None of them means that the shop is unauthorized.

title: Verify a retailer's authorization
